pages.title: 150 years of Vande Mataram — Rajya Sabha debate

facts.text: Occasion: Rajya Sabha discussion commemorating 150 years of Vande Mataram
facts.head: News

facts.text: J.P. Nadda (Leader of House): Vande Mataram should get the same constitutional status as the national anthem; Opposition (Mallikarjun Kharge) accused him of distorting history
facts.head: News

facts.text: Union Cabinet: nationwide celebration of 150 years
facts.head: News

facts.text: Author: Bankim Chandra Chattopadhyay — composed in Sanskrit (⚠ not Bengali)

facts.text: Translations: Marathi, Kannada (1897), Gujarati (1901), Hindi (1906), Telugu (1907), Tamil (1908), Malayalam (1909)

facts.text: 1937 CWC: only first two stanzas to be sung at national gatherings

facts.text: National song: designated by Dr Rajendra Prasad in the Constituent Assembly on 24 January 1950 — equal status with Jana Gana Mana
facts.head: Origin

facts.text: Views: Tagore backed first two stanzas; Gandhi (Harijan, July 1939) — drop if anyone objects in mixed gathering
facts.head: Origin

facts.text: ⚠ Article 51A(a) mentions Flag and Anthem, not the national song

facts.text: Date: December 1 — World AIDS Day
facts.head: News

facts.text: Theme 2025: "Overcoming disruption, transforming the AIDS response"
facts.head: News

facts.text: Context: why HIV remains incurable after 42 years of research
facts.head: News

facts.text: HIV identified: 1983 by Françoise Barré-Sinoussi and Luc Montagnier (Institut Pasteur)
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: Attacks: CD4 white blood cells (CD4+ T-cells); AIDS = advanced stage of untreated HIV
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: India supplies: 70% of global ART medicines
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: Cured cases: only a handful, all through bone-marrow transplants
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: Advanced HIV Disease (WHO): CD4 < 200 cells/mm³ or WHO Stage 3/4; all children < 5 years with HIV are AHD
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: Window period: antibodies develop in about 28 days; infants need virological testing at birth or 6 weeks
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: PEP: within 72 hours of exposure
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: WHO PrEP options: oral TDF-based PrEP, Dapivirine vaginal ring, long-acting injectable cabotegravir, long-acting injectable lenacapavir
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: Not transmitted by: kissing, hugging, handshakes, food, water, utensils
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: WHO strategy: Global Health Sector Strategies (GHSS) 2022–2030; end AIDS by 2030 (SDG 3.3)
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: Why hard to treat: retrovirus integrates into host DNA (reverse transcription), latent reservoirs, high mutation rate, destroys immune cells
facts.head: HIV facts

facts.text: Phase: NACP I; Years: 1992–1999; Key point: India's first comprehensive HIV/AIDS programme
facts.head: National AIDS Control Programme phases

facts.text: Phase: NACP II; Years: 1999–2006; Key point: Reduce spread; build national capacity
facts.head: National AIDS Control Programme phases

facts.text: Phase: NACP III; Years: 2007–2012; Key point: Halt and reverse by 2012; created DAPCUs (District AIDS Prevention and Control Units)
facts.head: National AIDS Control Programme phases

facts.text: Phase: NACP IV; Years: 2012–2017 (extended 2017–2021); Key point: 50% cut in new infections vs 2007; HIV/AIDS Act 2017, Mission Sampark, Test and Treat
facts.head: National AIDS Control Programme phases

facts.text: Phase: NACP V; Years: 2021–2026; Key point: Central Sector Scheme, outlay ₹15,471.94 crore
facts.head: National AIDS Control Programme phases

facts.text: Mission Sampark: bring back PLHIV lost to follow-up on ART
facts.head: National AIDS Control Programme phases

facts.text: NACP-V: dual HIV-syphilis test kits for antenatal screening
facts.head: National AIDS Control Programme phases

facts.text: Targeted Interventions: 1,587 TI projects (Oct 2025)
facts.head: National AIDS Control Programme phases

facts.text: Ombudsmen: appointed in 34 States/UTs under the HIV and AIDS (Prevention and Control) Act, 2017
facts.head: National AIDS Control Programme phases

pages.title: INSV Kaundinya — stitched ship's maiden overseas voyage

facts.text: Voyage: Indian Navy's stitched sailing vessel INSV Kaundinya — maiden overseas voyage Porbandar (Gujarat) → Muscat (Oman)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Inspired by: ship in Ajanta Cave paintings (5th century CE)
facts.head: News

facts.text: Built by: Ministry of Culture, Indian Navy, Hodi Innovations; Kerala artisans led by master shipwright Babu Sankaran
facts.head: News

facts.text: Method: Tankai method — hull stitched first, ribs later; coir rope, natural resin; no metal or engine
facts.head: News

facts.text: Item: Length; Detail: about 19.6 m
facts.head: Details

facts.text: Item: Width; Detail: about 6.5 m
facts.head: Details

facts.text: Item: Draft; Detail: about 3.33 m
facts.head: Details

facts.text: Item: Crew; Detail: about 15
facts.head: Details

facts.text: Symbols: sails — Gandabherunda and Sun; bow — Simha Yali; deck — Harappan-style stone anchor
facts.head: Details

facts.text: Named after: Kaundinya, ancient mariner linked to voyages to Southeast Asia
facts.head: Details

pages.title: Batadrava Than — birthplace of Srimanta Sankardeva redeveloped

facts.text: Inaugurated by: Amit Shah — ₹227-crore redeveloped Batadrava Than, Nagaon district, Assam
facts.head: News

facts.text: Official name: Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardeva Abhirbhav Kshetra; first proposed in Assam Budget 2021–22
facts.head: News

facts.text: Present: CM Himanta Biswa Sarma, Sarbananda Sonowal, Pabitra Margherita, Bimal Bora; Gayan-Bayan welcome; sanctum has the Guru Asana
facts.head: News

facts.text: Life: 1449–1568; family Siromani Bhuyans; pilgrimage 1481; first Borgeet at Badarikashrama (Badrinath)
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: Faith: Eka-Sarana-Nama-Dharma (Neo-Vaishnavism) — Krishna alone; rejected idol worship and caste; stressed Śravaṇa and Kīrtana
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: Institutions: Namghars (prayer halls), Satras (monasteries)
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: Literature: translated 8 of 12 books of Bhagavata Purana into Brajavali
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: Work: Kirtana-Ghosha; Note: Magnum opus
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: Work: Gunamala; Note: Condensed Bhagavata, composed in one night
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: Work: Bhakti Pradipa; Note: Against worship of other deities
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: Work: Rukmini Harana Kavya, HariScandra-Upakhyana; Note: Early works
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: Arts: Ankiya Naat (one-act plays), Bhaona, Sattriya dance (classical), about 240 Borgeets
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: ⚠ Sattriya is not based on songs of Tulsidas, Kabir, Mirabai (UPSC 2014)
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva

facts.text: Associated figure: Madhavdeva
facts.head: Srimanta Sankardeva
